title: Mx 1.0.0 is ready!
message:
• Fixed: the trash marker no longer rewrites message text — the red icon on the bubble is the only marker, so formatting, links and mentions on revoked messages stay where they belong
• Fixed: an oversized trash icon on bubbles with no timestamp node
• Fixed: settings could not be opened in the Chinese build of Turrit
• The tweak is now fully translated — every string follows the language you pick, instead of falling back to English
